description: Validate an RSA without creating it. Use this to check for errors before creating. Enforces: 3-15 headlines (≤30 chars), 2-4 descriptions (≤90 chars), ≥1 final URL, both path1 AND path2 present (≤15 chars each), ≥1 label. Also enforces a house floor of ≥15 headlines and ≥4 descriptions by default (mirroring google_ads_create_responsive_search_ad's pre-check) -- pass allow_partial_assets: true to preview a below-floor ad without that rejection.

allow_partial_assets.description: House-floor escape hatch. Defaults to false, meaning ≥15 headlines and ≥4 descriptions are required. Pass true to preview an ad with fewer (still subject to the API's own 3/2 minimums).

labels.description: At least 1 label required (e.g. 'claude-2026-04-12' for versioning). Enables later discovery and auditing.

path1.description: Display URL path segment 1 (required, max 15 chars). Shown in ad preview.

path2.description: Display URL path segment 2 (required, max 15 chars). Shown in ad preview.

name: google_ads_validate_ad
